name: Banatik
author: banan
description: Banatik — your MikroTik router in the Omarchy bar. WAN link and public IP, RouterOS version and pending firmware, CPU and memory, Wi-Fi clients with signal, DHCP devices, ZeroTier and WireGuard / Back To Home peers, logins, firewall counters, traffic charts up to 30 days and the router log, read over REST with a read-only user and a pinned certificate. Alerts when the internet link drops, the public IP changes, a new device joins or someone logs into the router.

barWidget.description: MikroTik router status: WAN, Wi-Fi clients, DHCP, tunnels, logins, log and traffic charts up to 30 days over REST. Click for the panel.

schema.label: Refresh interval when closed (seconds). Every refresh is one REST login on the router
Refresh interval while the panel is open (seconds)
Show a short label next to the bar icon
Bar label: wan (download/upload rate), clients (devices online), identity (router name)
Show a summary tooltip on hover
Read the DHCP lease and ARP tables (device list, host names for Wi-Fi clients)
Fetch the router log while the panel is open (last 40 lines, own logins filtered out)
Notify when the internet link goes down or comes back, the WAN or public address changes, or the router reboots
Notify when a device not seen before joins the network (DHCP lease or Wi-Fi association)
Notify when someone logs into the router from an address not seen before
Keep traffic history for this many days (5-minute averages; raw 30 s samples are kept 48 h). 7 and 30 unlock the 7d / 30d chart ranges
Directory for the history database (empty = ~/.cache/omarchy-banatik). Must exist, be yours, mode 0700, not a symlink
Demo mode: show an invented router instead of talking to a real one
